notes: Each run targets its own freshly seeded issue (see workspace scripts/seed_test_issues.sh); {N} is replaced with that issue number. Graded against live GitHub state by scripts/grade.py.

evals.name: capital-question
evals.prompt: Handle GitHub ticket #{N} in this repo — it's a question from the team.
evals.expected_output: 👀 before comment; one answer comment (Canberra) ending with the answer marker; issue left OPEN awaiting the reporter's acceptance.
assertions: Exactly one comment by own account
